annotationRationale: Expressing the same water amount as fractions of two capacities leads to the capacity ratio through fraction division.
sourceMethod: Followed the supplied official solution by assigning variables to the container capacities, equating the water amounts, and dividing to obtain their ratio.

review.mathCheck: Conservation of water gives (5/6)x=(3/4)y, hence x/y=(3/4)/(5/6)=9/10, choice D. The ratio is taken in the requested first-to-second order.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally phrased, mathematically faithful adaptation of official 2019 AMC 10B solution 1, page 2, using the same conserved-volume equation and fraction division.
review.annotationCheck: The variables clearly represent capacities, and the equation and ratio calculation are sufficient. Both selected concepts are directly exercised.
